notablePrerequisites:
Llanowar Mentor does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
You control a basic Forest.
description:
Cast Rite of Harmony by paying {G}{W}, allowing you to draw a card whenever a creature enters the battlefield this turn.
Activate a basic Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Llanowar Mentor by paying {G}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Llanowar Elves creature token.
The Llanowar Elves token enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm and Rite of Harmony.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Rite of Harmony trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Llanowar Elves token, untapping a basic Forest you control.
Repeat from step 2.
